title: 第十七章 姑娘不在第十八章 指证
content_zh:
有些事不知真相还好，知道了差点没给气乐了。
至于为什么会把自己给喊成了娘，她也算是记忆深刻。
记得当时也是不要脸的拍自己马屁来着，说自己长的多漂亮来着，又没读过什么书，翻来覆去也夸不出什么新花样，听多了反而膈应，她就让这大个子省省，说自己都能当她娘了…
谁知话还没说完，这大个子就扑通跪下了，干净利落的朝她喊了声娘。
怪吓人的，当时就把她给喊麻了，她本意是想让对方嘴巴放尊重点，可没说要认个儿子，忙说不是这个意思，让以后不要再喊了，然而以后的以后不管什么时候见面，人家都不改初衷，反正就这么喊上了。
然后每次都是一个喊，一个让不要喊。
要不是流放之地的规矩摆着，执徐城内不便动手，她觉得自己就算不将这便宜儿子打死，也能把其舌头给拔了。
她就不明白了，傻子都能看出这是想攀关系，哪有什么真心在，死皮赖脸的拉这种关系有意义吗？
然后就是最近，也不知下面人是操的哪门子闲心，送货出去时，特意向身在外界的她禀报了一下师春他们的情况，说东九原这一帮子弄到了大量物资，一伙人都弄到了脱离苦海的资格，一下就出来了一百多个。
这在流放之地绝不是小数目，而是极为庞大的数目，害她也有些好奇了，什么情况？
于是从出去的东九原人员中找了两个利索的，说要推荐两人进博望楼干活，问两人愿不愿意。
指的是外界的博望楼，博望楼在修行界的产业很大，她兰巧颜只负责流放之地的买卖。
对刚出流放之地的人来说，能进博望楼，那可是天大的好机会，哪能不乐意，一万个乐意。
可天下哪有这样白白的好事，自然是有条件的，结果这两人立马就将师春他们给卖了，把得到那批物资的经过讲了遍，而且为了套近乎，那是远的近都讲了不少。
其中就交代有吴斤两对很多女人喊过娘的事。
喊娘都是其次，问题是被吴斤两喊过娘的女人基本都落了个不得好死的下场，更过分的是，其中就有吴斤两亲自下毒手干掉的。
当面喊娘，背后捅刀子，这能是人干的事？
如今还敢跑来喊娘，她不气才怪，也只能是以执徐城内不宜动手来安慰自己。
好在她的气量似乎还可以，对发懵的吴斤两甩完脸色后，目光又落在了师春身上，语气稍微正常了点，“这是要出去了？”
也看出了跟往常不一样，吴斤两身上背了包袱行囊之类的。

师春文静颔首，努力摆出一副温文尔雅的样子道：“正是。”
对他这德行，兰巧颜可谓是皮笑肉不笑，老是缠着自己女儿，她岂能不了解一下这位东九原大当家是个什么货色，东九原自从这厮接手后，在这一带的赫赫凶名可不是装斯文装出来的，那是杀出来的，这厮手上不知染了多少血腥，是个十足的杀人不眨眼的货。
她表面上还是尽量不以为意道：“出去了也好，不过外面的规则和这里放任打杀的规则可不一样，自己多加小心吧。”
“是。”师春又拱手谢过，并顺口问道：“老板娘，苗姑娘呢？”
这话问的兰巧颜有些无语，她也不知道这到底是怎么了，莫非是孽缘不成？
把女儿放在生狱十二城跑着圈的盘账，是为了让女儿学习练手，将来想在博望楼有所作为，不会看账怎么行。她也没想过让女儿一辈子呆在这鸟不拉屎的流放之地，加上眼前这小子死皮赖脸的追求，花样挺多，还真怕时间久了女儿家的会扛不住。也没什么看得起或看不起，就是两人身份地位相差太大了，真不合适。
于是三个月前，也就是女儿上次来此盘过账后，她就把女儿弄出去了，给女儿在外界的博望楼谋了事做。
好嘛，一回头，眼前这厮就把东九原一伙人的离去问题全部解决了，自己也要出去了，这不是赶巧的不能再赶巧了吗？搞的她好像在为两个小年轻提前铺路似的。
问题是博望楼并非儿戏之地，也不是说她把女儿调回来或再换个地方会有什么问题，她要调的话问题也不大，只是这随意调来调去不合适，才刚调过去多久？成了势的地方自有规矩，做事得有讲究，整个博望楼又不是她一个人说的算。
所以她不愿告诉对方自己女儿的下落，遂敷衍道：“有事，这次盘账没来。”
content_en:
It's okay not to know the truth about some things, but I'm almost not happy to know them.
As for why she called herself a mother, she had a deep memory.
I remember that she shamelessly flattered herself at that time, saying how beautiful she was, and she hadn’t read any books, so she couldn’t come up with any new ideas over and over again. After hearing too much about it, she felt resentful, so she asked the big man to save his time and said that she could be her mother...
Unexpectedly, before she finished speaking, the big man knelt down and called her mother cleanly.
It was so scary that he called her numb at that time. Her original intention was to ask the other party to be more respectful, but she did not say that she wanted to recognize a son. She quickly said that was not what she meant and told her not to call her again. However, no matter when they met in the future, they would not change their original intention and they would just call him that.
Then every time there was a shout and a shout not to be made.
If it weren't for the rules of the Exile Land, which made it inconvenient for Zhixu City to do anything, she felt that even if she didn't beat this cheap son to death, she could still pull out his tongue.
She didn't understand. Even a fool could see that this was an attempt to establish a relationship. There was no sincerity in it. Was there any point in pursuing such a relationship shamelessly?
Then recently, I don't know how careless the people below are. When delivering goods, they deliberately reported the situation of Shi Chun and others to her in the outside world, saying that the Dongjiuyuan group had obtained a large amount of supplies, and that a group of people had obtained the qualifications to escape the sea of ​​suffering. More than a hundred people came out at once.
This was by no means a small amount in the Exiled Land, but an extremely huge amount, which made her a little curious, what was going on?
So I found two smart people among the Dongjiuyuan people who had gone out, and said that I would recommend them to work in Bowang Tower, and asked them if they were willing.
It refers to the Bowang Tower in the outside world. Bowang Tower has a huge property in the cultivation world. She, Lan Qiaoyan, is only responsible for the sale of the place of exile.
For those who have just left the place of exile, being able to enter Bowang Tower is a great opportunity. How can you not be happy about it?
But there are no such free things in the world. Of course, there are conditions. As a result, these two people immediately sold Shi Chun and the others, and told them how they got the batch of materials. In order to get closer, they talked a lot about them.
Among them, it was revealed that Wu Jinliang had called many women "mother".
Calling her "mother" is secondary. The problem is that women who were called "mother" by Wu Jinliang basically met a bad end. What's even worse is that some of them were killed by Wu Jinliang himself.
Calling your mother in front of your face and stabbing her in the back, how can this be done by a human being?
Now she dares to come and call her mother. It's strange that she is not angry. She can only comfort herself by saying that it is not appropriate to take action in Zhixu City.
Fortunately, her energy seemed to be okay. After turning her face away from the confused Wu Jinliang, her eyes fell on Shi Chun again, and her tone was a little normal, "Are you going out?"
I also saw that Wu Jinliang was different from usual. He was carrying luggage and the like.
Shi Chun Wenjing nodded, tried his best to look gentle and said: "Exactly."
Regarding his virtues, Lan Qiaoyan can be said to be smiling but not smiling at all. She is always pestering her daughter. How could she not understand what kind of person this Dongjiuyuan leader is? Ever since this guy took over, Dongjiuyuan's reputation in this area was not just pretending to be polite, it was acquired through killing. I don't know how much blood was stained on this guy's hands, and he was a murderer without batting an eyelid.
On the surface, she tried not to take it seriously and said: "It's okay to go out, but the rules outside are different from the rules here where killing is allowed. Just be more careful."
"Yes." Shi Chun thanked her again and asked smoothly: "Madam boss, where is Miss Miao?"
Lan Qiaoyan was speechless when she asked this question. She didn't know what was going on. Could it be a bad fate?
The reason why I put my daughter in the twelve cities of Hell is to let my daughter learn to practice, so that she can make a difference in Bowang Tower in the future.Because, how can I do it if I don’t know how to read accounts? She never thought about letting her daughter stay in this barren place of exile for the rest of her life, and with the shameless pursuit of this kid in front of her, he had many tricks, and she was really afraid that her daughter's family would not be able to handle it as time went by. There's nothing to look down on or look down on, it's just that the difference in status between the two is so big that it's really inappropriate.
So three months ago, that is, after her daughter came to this place to settle accounts last time, she took her daughter out and found a job for her in Bowang Tower outside.
Well, as soon as I turned around, I saw that this guy in front of me had solved all the problems of the Dongjiuyuan group's departure, and he was about to leave. Isn't this a coincidence that can only be rushed? It seemed like she was paving the way for the two young people in advance.
The problem is that Bowang Tower is not a place for children to play, and it doesn't mean that there will be any problems if she transfers her daughter back or to another place. It won't be a big problem if she wants to transfer her daughter. It's just that it's not appropriate to transfer her here and there at will. How long has it been since she was transferred? A place that has become powerful has its own rules, and things must be done with care. She does not have the final say in the entire Bowang Tower.
So she didn't want to tell the other party the whereabouts of her daughter, so she said perfunctorily: "Something happened, so I didn't come for the accounting this time."
